comment: Read from the repository at commit ce83bfe, whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.1; the repository's head is one commit later and changes when the output voltage is written. The MIDI input port is configured in BaseModule.cpp line 9 but the widget never places a jack for it, so it cannot be clicked and gets no line: the device is chosen in the MidiDisplay at the top of the panel instead. The velocity and aftertouch outputs are likewise configured and never placed, so they too get nothing. Every jack is single channel. The voltage ranges given are the ones the module starts with; each jack's own right-click menu can set any of six ranges, so a patch may differ. The knob outputs are relative: the controller's knobs are endless encoders sending only up or down, and the module keeps a running total, moved by the turn speed and divided into as many steps as the resolution says, then scaled into the voltage range. The channel numbered 15 in the source is MIDI channel 16 as a person counts them, and it is reserved for the MiniLab to address its pads; MiniLab.cpp line 47 puts the channel back to all channels if it is chosen here. The faders are handled before the active check at MiniLab.cpp line 108, which is why they keep working while a pad is held.
